column1: Number of Code Blocks per Sub-Frame (Note 3)

Note 1:For FDD mode, up to 6 subframes (#1/2/3/6/7/8) are available for MBMS, in line with TS 36.331.Note 2:2 OFDM symbols are reserved for PDCCH; and reference signal allocated as per TS 36.211.Note 3:If more than one Code Block is present, an additional CRC sequence of L = 24 Bits is attached to each Code Block (otherwise L = 0 Bit).
